d: Jet black, straight hair with long locks and face-framing bangs, paired with sharp, narrow crimson eyes and a stoic expression. This adolescent youth has a slender build and wears a blue pleated skirt under a long, oversized black camouflage tactical coat with orange lining and yellow accents, complemented by a white collared shirt and blue tie. Black thigh-high stockings with teal gem accents and black lace-up boots with yellow trim complete the look. The character holds a large, matte black sniper rifle with integrated optics.
